detail.title: Intex Infra Cook 2200W Infrared Cooktop
detail.overview: Upgrade your kitchen with the Intex Infra Cook, a high-performance infrared cooktop designed for modern homes. Unlike traditional induction stoves, this infrared technology is compatible with all types of cookware, including aluminum, clay pots, and stainless steel. With a powerful 2200W heating element and a sleek premium crystal glass surface, it combines elegant aesthetics with rugged durability. Whether you're searing a BBQ, simmering a hot pot, or stir-frying vegetables, the feather-touch controls and smooth adjustment knob give you precision at your fingertips. Safety is a priority with built-in overheat protection and a rust-proof body, ensuring a long-lasting and worry-free culinary experience.

General.Universal Cookware Compatibility: Works seamlessly with Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Cast Iron, Enameled Iron, and Ceramic.
General.High Power Output: 2200 Watts for rapid heating and reduced cooking time.
General.Dual Control System: Equipped with both Feather Touch Controls and a Smooth Temperature Control Knob for precision.
General.Smart Cooking Modes: Pre-programmed settings for Stir-Fry, BBQ, Hot Pot, and Steam.
General.Premium Build: High-quality Crystal Glass Surface that is easy to clean and heat-resistant.
General.Enhanced Safety: Built-in Overheat Protection and a Rust-Proof metal body.
General.Digital Interface: Clear 4-digit Bright LED Display to monitor time and temperature.
General.Convenience Features: Built-in Timer for automated cooking and sturdy side handles for easy portability.
General.Elegant Design: Brushed silver finish with a minimalist black glass top.
